mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM users
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, phone, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
